تحتاجون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَاجُونَ (taḥtājūna) /taħ.taː.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَاجَ (iḥtāja)
# تُحْتَاجُونَ (tuḥtājūna) /tuħ.taː.d͡ʒuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَاجَ (iḥtāja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
